WITH drug1_source AS (
  SELECT concept_id FROM omop.concept WHERE vocabulary_id = 'RxNorm' AND concept_code = '313782'
),
drug1_mapped AS (
  SELECT concept_id_2 AS concept_id
  FROM drug1_source cs
  JOIN omop.concept_relationship cr ON cs.concept_id = cr.concept_id_1
  WHERE cr.relationship_id = 'Maps to'
),
drug1_concepts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ca.descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
  FROM drug1_mapped cm
  JOIN omop.concept c ON cm.concept_id = c.concept_id
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON c.concept_id = ca.ancestor_concept_id
),
drug1_exposures AS (
  SELECT de.person_id, de.drug_exposure_start_date AS start_date
  FROM omop.drug_exposure de
  JOIN drug1_concepts d1 ON de.drug_concept_id = d1.concept_id
),
drug2_source AS (
  SELECT concept_id FROM omop.concept WHERE vocabulary_id = 'RxNorm' AND concept_code = '1049621'
),
drug2_mapped AS (
  SELECT concept_id_2 AS concept_id
  FROM drug2_source cs
  JOIN omop.concept_relationship cr ON cs.concept_id = cr.concept_id_1
  WHERE cr.relationship_id = 'Maps to'
),
drug2_concepts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ca.descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
  FROM drug2_mapped cm
  JOIN omop.concept c ON cm.concept_id = c.concept_id
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON c.concept_id = ca.ancestor_concept_id
),

  JOIN drug2_concepts d2 ON de.drug_concept_id = d2.concept_id

WHERE CAST(
